Sandstone is a Software Development company. Sandstone is an ai-native operating system for in-house legal departments, providing a single platform to manage and resolve legal requests with agents. It unifies legal data, drives end-to-end workflows, and or. Sandstone employs 48 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with presence in South Africa.

## About

Sandstone is a comprehensive solution for intake, triage, execution, cataloging, and measurement of legal work, directly in the business tools teams already use. 

Sandstone connects every company, person, and document related to legal work into a single connected system of record to route, draft, and execute work.

# Gosford Quarries Sandstone

Gosford Quarries Sandstone is a Wholesale Building Materials company. Gosford Quarries is a leading Australian natural sandstone supplier. They offer a wide range of products and services in various categories such as residential, commercial, civil, heritage, and professional partners. They also provide architectural specifications, epd sandstone documentation, CPD course, quarry tours, stonemasons & installers, landscapers & installers, and more. Gosford Quarries focuses on environmental sustainability and. Gosford Quarries Sandstone employs 34 people (+17.2% YoY, +5 people) and has an annual revenue of $20.5M. Headquartered in Terrey Hills, New South Wales, Australia, with offices in Beaudesert, annandale, Somersby, and Clayton South.

## About

Gosford Quarries Sandstone is Australia's largest, oldest and most experienced supplier of 100% natural Australian sandstone. 

Since 1922 Gosford Quarries have been the leaders and experts in Australian sandstone. 

With access to exclusive sandstone quarries in NSW and QLD, Gosford Quarries boast the largest variety of Sandstone colours, textures and sandstone products for any project. 

Gosford Quarries is the most trusted and specified Sandstone supplier to the Commercial, Heritage, Residential, Civil & Landscape sectors and continue to be entrusted with supplying sandstone to the most prestigious and iconic projects in Australia.

For over 100 years, Gosford Quarries sandstone have lead the way in innovative processing technologies and strive to continue supplying the industry with the highest quality Australian sandstone for affordable prices.
 
From Rustic retaining wall blocks and crushed civil materials to sophisticated customisable sandstone cladding, paving, capping and intricate profiled carving, Gosford Quarries have the resources and capabilities to supply stone to any project.

Gosford Quarries is 100% Australian family owned and operated and is committed to supporting Australian jobs and keeping stonemasonry alive in Australia. GQ is also committed to environmental sustainability and ensure that all our sandstone is sourced, extracted and processed responsibly. 

Gosford Quarries are the experts in all things sandstone and are known as “The Sandstone people since 1922”. 

For more information on how to use Australian sandstone in your next project, contact our expert team 8585 8282.
